'''Bardo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked aboard [[Olag Greck]]'s droid barge.<ref name="CSWE" /> He was in charge of transporting [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88B]] to [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]].
